ICC Chairman Declares Women's Cricket in Golden Era

International Cricket Council (ICC) Chairman Jay Shah has stated that women's cricket is currently experiencing a golden era. He highlighted the power, passion, and class displayed by players throughout a recent tournament. This statement comes as the sport continues to gain prominence and viewership.
